description: List Follow On Tours' golf trips — the Trump portfolio venues, with the courses played, the hotel, nights, rounds and maximum group size, and a link to each trip's page. Use this for any golf enquiry. No payment is taken online. Most are priced on request; a set-price week (such as Sri Lanka) carries `dates` and per-person `prices` in GBP, which are the prices on its public page and may be quoted exactly as given. Golf trips are separate from the cricket tours in list_tours.
name: list_golf_trips
